courses.overview: 從超文字、HTTP 與早期科學資訊共享延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend hypertext, http and early scientific information sharing to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: ARPANET 歷史網路架構
related.why: Web 建立在已存在的網際連通上
related.whyEn: Web builds on existing Internet connectivity
related.transfer: Web 建立在已存在的網際連通上
related.transferEn: Web builds on existing Internet connectivity
related.difference: 超文字與 HTTP 是應用層概念
related.differenceEn: Hypertext and HTTP are application-layer concepts

place.name: 早期網路研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「ARPANET 歷史網路架構」共用的資料／元件介面；以「Web 建立在已存在的網際連通上」指出能保留的條件。
針對「超文字與 HTTP 是應用層概念」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with arpanet historical network architecture; use "Web builds on existing Internet connectivity" to identify retained conditions.
For "Hypertext and HTTP are application-layer concepts", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summary: 全球資訊網早期伺服器系統從超文字、HTTP 與早期科學資訊共享連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Early World Wide Web server systems connects interfaces, data and acceptance through hypertext, http and early scientific information sharing. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「歷史角色」到「演進報告」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect historical roles to evolution reports, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: CERN 公開歷史和初期專案頁讓超文字設計可追溯；HTTP/1.0 作後續標準比較，不冒充首版實現。
history.textEn: CERN history and early project pages trace hypertext design; HTTP/1.0 is a later comparison, not a claim about the first implementation.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.

roles.role: 第一台 Web 伺服器運行於 NeXT 電腦；NeXT 於 1997 年併入蘋果。
roles.roleEn: The first web server ran on a NeXT computer; NeXT merged into Apple in 1997.
roles.business: 設計個人運算裝置、自研晶片與作業系統，並主導 LLVM/Swift 編譯器生態。
roles.businessEn: Designs personal computing devices, in-house silicon and operating systems, and drives the LLVM/Swift compiler ecosystem.

roles.role: 1998 年創立的 CDN 先驅，因應早期 Web 規模化需求；屬產業關聯。
roles.roleEn: CDN pioneer founded in 1998 to scale the early Web; an industry association.
roles.business: 經營 CDN、邊緣安全與分散式雲端運算。
roles.businessEn: Operates a CDN, edge security and distributed cloud computing.

courses.connection: 從「全球資訊網早期伺服器系統」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Early World Wide Web server systems. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
